correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the real normalized first-band orthonormal basis and reproducing kernel. For each coordinate replacement, the conditional signed expectation is a nonnegative three-region piecewise-affine function; the integer interval t-1<k+(p/q)l<t proves strictness except the exact last-coordinate resonance. The binomial negative-part recurrence proves the finite formula for all dimensions; classical CLT/Poisson convergence plus uniform integrability prove the limits. Direct exact-rational kernel enumeration corroborates all norming rows over 364 evaluation cases. Finite computation is explicitly not the proof.

value.rationale: The object is the canonical least-squares first-band projector on a biased product design. The norm directly measures worst-case amplification of bounded data, and p-biased coordinate sampling is a standard nonuniform design. Exact rare-corner extremizer rigidity with dimension–bias integer resonances is a nontrivial global classification, and the Gaussian sqrt(d) vs rare-event Poisson d scaling is a sharp structural shift with a countable set of cusp parameters; neither is supplied by a routine orthogonal-basis calculation alone. The stated breadth (all d≥2 and every p∈(0,1)) and explicit reproducible formulas give a natural reusable invariant.
